content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to modify the gain setting in the analog amplifier block using an analog input such as a potentiometer or 0-10V signal?

Direct modification of the gain value in a [product_name] program using an analog input is not supported. You can only adjust the gain through the display, operator panel, or remotely using another [product_name] device, an HMI, or related app. To implement gain control via analog input, you need to use a different analog block, like a mathematical function within the program. An example is included in the attachment.
Got it, thank you very much!

analysis.insight_summary: A user wanted to know if the gain setting of an analog amplifier block could be dynamically adjusted via an analog input. The responses clarified this couldn't be done directly through the program, and such changes are only possible by using displays or remote controls. As an alternative, it was suggested to use a mathematical function block to achieve similar functionality, which highlights a restriction in real-time parameter adjustment with analog signals for this system.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is seeking a way to change the gain setting of an analog amplifier block dynamically using an external analog input, aiming for flexible and responsive system control.
